SELECT m.home_store_id, count(*) AS versions, count(DISTINCT m.member_id) AS members, sum(CASE WHEN is_current THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS cur_rows, count(DISTINCT CASE WHEN is_current THEN member_id END) AS cur_members, min(join_date), max(join_date)
FROM dim_member m WHERE m.home_store_id IN (115,116,117,136,900,999) GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

SELECT count(*) AS rows_, count(DISTINCT member_id) AS members, count(DISTINCT CASE WHEN is_current THEN member_id END) AS cur_members, sum(CASE WHEN is_current THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS cur_rows, max(valid_from), min(join_date), max(join_date) FROM dim_member

calls.statement:
WITH cur AS (
  SELECT member_id, home_store_id FROM dim_member WHERE is_current AND home_store_id IN (115,116,117,136)
),
ever AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT member_id FROM dim_member WHERE home_store_id IN (115,116,117,136)
),
act AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT m.member_id
  FROM fact_sales_line f
  JOIN dim_member m ON m.member_key = f.member_key
  JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key = f.store_key
  JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key = f.product_key
  WHERE s.store_id <> 999 AND p.category <> 'ZZ Test'
    AND f.sale_date > DATE '2026-10-04' - 364 AND f.sale_date <= DATE '2026-10-04'
)
SELECT (SELECT count(DISTINCT member_id) FROM cur) AS current_home_tampere,
       (SELECT count(*) FROM ever) AS ever_home_tampere,
       (SELECT count(*) FROM cur c JOIN act a USING (member_id)) AS active_current_home_tampere,
       (SELECT count(*) FROM ever e JOIN act a USING (member_id)) AS active_ever

WITH tampere_members AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT m.member_id
  FROM dim_member m
  JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_id = m.home_store_id AND s.is_current
  WHERE m.is_current AND s.city = 'Tampere' AND s.store_id < 900
),
active_members AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT m.member_id
  FROM fact_sales_line f
  JOIN dim_member m ON m.member_key = f.member_key
  JOIN dim_store st ON st.store_key = f.store_key
  JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key = f.product_key
  WHERE st.store_id <> 999 AND p.category <> 'ZZ Test'
    AND f.sale_date > DATE '2026-10-04' - 364 AND f.sale_date <= DATE '2026-10-04'
)
SELECT count(*) AS active_members_tampere FROM tampere_members t JOIN active_members a USING (member_id)
